## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `Scripts/test.sh`
- [ ] `Scripts/check-public-repo.sh`

## Privacy checklist

- [ ] No real recordings, transcripts, debug logs, model data, certificates, or keys are included.
- [ ] Logs and screenshots are synthetic or fully redacted.
- [ ] Capture scope, storage, networking, permissions, and notification behavior are documented when changed.
